title: Naydenov Gymnastics

services.name: Gymnastics Classes for Girls
services.desc: This page lists the various gymnastics classes offered for girls. It does not include the girls competitive team (levels 3-10)** All of our classes start with approximately 8 minutes of warm-ups. Stretching promotes a healthy lifestyle and is occasionally done in the middle or at the end of the workout. Classes sometimes finish with 2 to 3 minutes of fun time in the foam pits, swing, trampolines, rope glide, slide, bounce house, or with the parachute. Most classes usually cover 3 events. Our coaches continually strive to bring fun and excitement to each class by introducing new skills, and practice drills. services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Best value for great Vancouver birthday parties. Have a blast playing on the rope glide, foam pits, slide, gymnastics equipment, trampolines, and more. Birthday party reservations for 12 yrs and under start at $75 (does not include bracelets) plus sales tax. Open gym bracelets are $20 per participant for regular entry or $25 for the upgraded bungee bracelet. Basic party is a 2hr reservation, includes four reserved black tables in the mezzanine, bracelets are an additional cost. Enough seating for up to 12 participants (children). Book additional reservations or VIP reservation for more seating space. The VIP birthday party reservations cost $200 (does not include bracelets) plus sales tax
